summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited consolidated net revenues for April 2026. The filing includes revenue figures in NT$ and US$ for the company and its ATM segment, with sequential and year-over-year comparisons. This is a routine monthly revenue disclosure. No terms, transactions, or special situations are present. The filing is a standard periodic report and does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. There are no deal terms or events that would classify it as a special situation.
